svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut nine bottom fins 264 mm and nine top fins 176 mm long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (two 3.66 m bars also give the two 40 mm indicator guards).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; keep the long edges straight (roll them on a flat plate).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each fin stands on edge, 6.35 mm tall, on 16.55 mm centres;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outer fins are 10 mm in from the side faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom fins start 8 mm in from each tube end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top fins start 8 mm in from the key end and stop 96 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: short of the handle end, leaving the label band clear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond with the 120 degree C epoxy: a thin bead under the edge and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a fillet down each side. Hold them upright in a slotted comb

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (a wooden strip sawn at the fin pitch) while the epoxy cures.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every fin upright, none touching a screw hole.
